title: António Costa resigns
summary: António Costa resigned on 7 November 2023, hours after searches in an inquiry into lithium and hydrogen projects and after a communiqué of the Public Prosecutor's Office said his conduct was being examined separately at the Supreme Court. The naming was afterwards disputed and attributed in part to a confusion in the transcripts; by then the resignation had been accepted and parliament was dissolved.
